package.name: crowd_nav_perception
package.description: Phase 5: HumanStateSource interface, GroundTruthHumanSource (wrapping Phase 4's PedestrianArray topic + a seeded, sim-time-keyed perception degradation model). Also LidarHumanTrackerSource: a real, non-ground-truth HumanStateSource built from the robot's own /scan (clustering + frame-to-frame tracking + TF-based frame conversion) - the TrackedHumanSource seam this package always documented but left as a stub, filled in ahead of real-hardware bring-up (docs/lidar_perception-findings.md). Zero Nav2 dependency by design (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md S2) - unit-testable in plain colcon/gtest without spinning up simulation.
